description: Prepare the 3-qubit GHZ state (|000> + |111>)/sqrt(2) and measure all qubits.
prompt: Write a Python function named build_circuit() that takes no arguments and returns a qiskit QuantumCircuit with exactly 3 qubits. The circuit must prepare the GHZ state (|000> + |111>)/sqrt(2) starting from |000>, then measure all 3 qubits into classical bits. Use only the qiskit package. Return the circuit; do not run it. Answer with the code only.
